Then old Mr Miller stood up, apologized for the burned delivery truck, and offered shared use of his warehouse. Mrs Okafor wept, accepted, and proposed a joint scholarship for the school. The crowd applauded for several minutes, and after decades of bitterness they finally made peace yesterday.
